tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gshin po rjes 'dzin sgrib pa kun sbyong bzhugs/ /

na mo mañdzu badz+rā ya/ gdod nas 'chi bdag dgra la rnam rgyal bas/ khyab bdag 'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes la/ /btud nas 'chi bas rnam par nyams pa rnams| |rjes 'dzin 'chi dang rjes 'brel cho ga bshad/ /'dir gshin po rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs lho sgo'i cho ga sgrib pa kun sbyong zhes bya ba bshad pa bya ste/ de yang rgyud sde spyi dang khyad par dus 'khor rtsa ba'i rgyud nas gsungs pa la brten te lag len gtso bor dus 'khor dang sbyar nas brjod par bya'o/ /'di la gsum/ rgyud sde'i gshin chog la log rtog dgag /de rgyud sde nas ji ltar gsungs tshul dgod/ de lag len la ji ltar btab pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la log rtog chen po dang 'bring dang chung ngu dgag pa'o/ /spyi rnam shes dgug gzhug khyad par ro la dbang bskur/ bye brag skyes tshar nas cho ga dang mdor na de la dmigs pa'i dge ba mi 'thad pa dgag pa'o/ /dang po la/ mdo dang 'dul ba dang rtog ge'i tshul cung zad sbyangs pas mkhas pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis non cing*/ rgyud sde rin po che rnams mthong ba'i skal ba dman pa mang po dang*/ der ma zad 'dul ba bstod lugs pa dag kyang gshin po'i rnam shes ro la dgug byed pa ni mi 'thad de/ bkug kyang mi khugs pa'i phyir/ khugs na shi ba gsos par thal la/ 'dod mi nus te/ chos mngon pa las/ srog gi dbang po ni rnam smin skyes yin pa dang*/ gzugs can ma yin pa'i rnam sm-in lan cig chad nas mtshams sbyor bar mi srid par gsungs pa'i phyir/ sman blar shi ba gsos pa skad du gsungs pa yang re shig brgyal nas rmi lam rmis pa ltar| srog lus dang ma bral ba bzhin du rnam shes gshin rje'i yul du 'khyams pa cho ga'i nus pas slar yang lus la zhugs pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes smra zhing*/ des na gshin po'i ched du dmigs nas cho ga rnams dag byed pa yin gyis/ rnam shes dgug gzhug sogs mi blun po mgo bskor ba'i phyir du rdo rje slob dpon rdzus mas byas so zhes zer ro/

/'di ni shin du mi rigs te/ shi nas ldog mi srid pa dang*/ bar do lan cig grub nas gang grub de'i skye ba len dgos kyi bar do nyid du ldog mi srid pa dang*/ khams gong gi sems las ma nyams bzhin du 'dod par skye mi srid pa dang*/ byang sems la 'phags pa'i skye ba rgyud mi srid pa dang*/ lus ngag gi mi dge ba gzugs can bdun la gnang ba'i skabs mi srid pa dang*/ de bzhin du spang bya sgrib pa gnyis gnyen po bdag med gnyis kyi shes rab mi srid pa sogs ni/ nyan thos sde pa theg chen bkar mi 'dod pa'i grub mtha' yin la/ dngos bstan de ltar ston pa'i mdo dang lung rnams dang nyan thos thabs la mi mkhas pa'i gzhi lam la lhag par mos pa khyed cag lta bu dag rims kyis drang ba'i ched du gsungs pa'i dgongs pa can yin pa'i phyir/ des na shi ba gsos par mchog mi 'gyur du gsal bar gsungs shing*| sman bla'i mdo yang kun dga' bo dang skyabs grol gnyis kyi brgal lan la brtag na shi ba gsos pa kho nar gsal te dus min du 'chi ba dgu gsungs nas| shi tshar ba zhig mdo sde'i cho ga khyad par can gyis nus pas gsos par gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na spyir theg chen gyi bsam sbyor khyad par can dang khyad par du mdo dang sngags kyi cho ga dang gzungs sngags sogs kyi nus pas theg chen gyi gzhung du ji skad bshad pa las ldog pa kho nas gsungs pa rtaug ge pa skal dman dag gi ngor theg chen bka' sgrub dgos pa byung ba yin no/ /de ltar gong na lta zhog /theg dman rang gzhung las kyang*/ drang srong yid khros pa tsam gyi dan+ta ka'i grong khyer bsregs par bshad pa sogs sems kyi nus pa khyad par can bshad pa rnams go na yang*/ spyir theg chen/ dgos rdo rje theg pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu la log rtogs 'di lta bu ga la 'byung*/ khyad par stod lugs pa sogs sngags kyi brda chad cung zad yod pa la ni dogs pa 'di lta bu'i gnas med de/

zhi rgyas dbang drag gang la yang rang rang gi sgrub bya rnams ky-i rnam shes bkugs nas de la bya ba byed par gsungs pa sha stag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rnam shes dgug gzhug 'thad du chug kyang*/ kho rang gi bar do'i yid lus nyid la cho ga bya ba 'am/ yang na kho rang gson dus gang la chags pa'i gos dang rgyan lta bu la bcug nas bya bar rigs kyi ro la 'jug pa ni shin tu mi rigs te/ spyir ro zhes bya ba yid 'byung zhing 'bros pa'i gnas su mthong gi 'chags pa'i gnas ma yin/ khyad par rang gi ro la khyi ror mthong ba sogs bshad kyi rnam shes 'khor bar ma bshad pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ 'di yang rig pa ltar snang yin ste/ rang gi gos la gos su mthong na rang gi lus la lus su mi mthong ba mi rigs shing khyi ror mthong bar bshad na'ang tshad ldan gyi lung ma yin la rgyud dang mkhas pa'i gzhung nas ro la 'jug tshul rgyas par gsungs la| sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gy-i nus pas 'jug par nus shing*/ khyad par sngon du ro la bsnyen pa sogs byas nas shin tu yang bzhug par sla ba dang gal te 'jug ma nus kyang kho rang gi lus rnying pa la sbyangs khrus dbang bskur byas na shin tu phan che te/ dri chu'i sa la mnan pa byas pa sogs kyang gnod tshabs che bar rgya cher gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ khyad par skye ba blangs tshar nas de la dmigs pa'i dge rtsa tsam bya yi rnam shes bkug nas dbang bskur bar sus kyang mi nus pas mi mthad do zhe na/ bsgrub bya gson pau rgyang ring na gnas pa yang yid lus kyi rnam par bkug ste/ dkyil 'khor du bcug pa la zhi rgyas dbang drag mtha' dag bya bar rgyud sde kun las gsungs pa ma mthong zhing ma thos par rig pa ltar gnyid kyis myos pa'i rlab chol du zad do/ /bzhi pa ni/ chos log gi gzhung lugs ngan pa'i ngag rgyun dngos dang*/ de dag gi lhad 'dres pa dang*/ gdon rigs 'ga' zhig gi rmi lam dang snang ba bsgyur ba'am mo dang rtsis la sogs pa 'bab tu bcug pas 'khrul par gyur pa mang po ni/

de'i don du dge ba byas pa ni don med de/ kho rang gi ji tsam thob pa'i mi dang nor la sogs pa lhan cig sba ba dang bsregs pa dang bsad pa la sogs pa bya bar rigs so zhes dang*/ kho rang la byin pas thob par rmi lam dang mig mthong sogs kyis mthong ba 'ga' zhig gis lus dngos su ston pa'ang byung bar grags pas de ltar bya'o zhes dang*/ dge ba byed mi dgos pa dang*/ byas kyang mi thob pa dang*/ byas kyang mi phan pa'i gang zag la sogs pa dang*/ nye du rnams kyis mya ngan ma byas na gshin po mi dga' ba dang*/ ngud mo drag pos sla nas bos na sla 'khor ro zhes sogs kyi chos log mang du byung zhing da dung yang phal cher nyams su len pa yang snang ngo*/ de bzhin du blun po la grags pa bu dang chos gnyis rang gis byas pa dgos so zhes pa ltar/ dge ba rnams kho rang ma shi gong nas byas pa dgos kyi de'i ched du dmigs pas de la mi phan te/ phan na sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis dus rtag tu ngan song gsum la sogs pa'i ched du dge ba rnams mdzad kyi yod pas 'bad med du grol bar 'gyur ro zhes sogs smra bar byed do/ /'di dag ni yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gsung rab rin po che'i mtsho 'gram du ba tsha'i khron pa nan gis brko ba/ blang dor gyi mig long ba/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mig pu bas thar ba'i grong du khrid kyang de nan gyis dor te/ log lta'i g.yang sa chen por mchong ba la mngon par brtson pa dag gi 'dod pa yin pas bstan 'dzin chen po rnams kyis rgya cher bkag zin cing*/ nag phyogs kyi 'byung po dag gi yid dang snang ba bsgyur tshul sngon yang mang du byung ba/ ngams gta' ra klu gong dang*/ grub chen nyi phugs pa dang*/ bon po g.yu thul can gyi gtam rgyud kyis shes la/ khyad par 'dod pa tha ma ni/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu dang bdag 'bras kyi dbye ba ma shes shing*/ cho ga byas pas nad pa la phan pa'i mdo tshad mar khas slangs nas gshin po la mi phan par 'dod pa shin tu 'gal ba zad do/

/gnyis pa ni/ spyir gshin po rjes 'dzin shin du'ang 'thad mod kyi/ de ni bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis de'i ched du gsungs pa'i kun rig nyid la rten par rigs kyi/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi nyams len khyad par can rnams gshin chog la 'khyer ba ni shin tu mi rigs so zhes sngags kyi lam khyad la mkhas par rlom pa dag zer ro/ /'o na dus 'khor rtsa rgyud dang*/ rdo rje gur dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs las gsungs shing*/ grub chen swa dhu pu tras dus tha ma'i cho ga dus 'khor la dang*/ gur 'grel lha'i rigs kyis brtul zhugs kyis mdzad par gshin chog gur rigs bsdus ma dang*/ /nag po pas gshin chog kyai rdor la dang*| ro bsreg kyai rdor dang gshin rje gshed la dang*/ ār+ya de bas ro bsregs dang*| stong nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes/ gshin po bde gshegs gnas la 'god pa'i cho ga gsang 'dus la sbyar ba sogs mi mthad par 'dod dgos pa'am/ yang na kun rig las gzhan pa'i gshin chog kho bos ma mthong pas med do zhes smros shig /rigs pa yang bla med zab pas/ spyir gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i chos ma yin no zhes sam/ rung kyang de'i snod rung gi gshin po med do zhes smra dgos na de yang mi mthad do/ /'on kyang gson dus kyi bla med kyi dbang rdzogs par ma thob pa la ni/ khrus dang bum dbang tsam nas rims kyis gzhug pa sogs ni gzhung de dag las gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ de dag dang sbyong rgyud rnam gnyis cha lag dang bcas pa sogs la legs par sbyangs shing thugs su chud pa'i mkhas mchog dag gis kyang*| thog mar ro'i bsnyen pa'i skabs su rnam shes dgug gzhug ma mdzad pa ni| mi thob pa'i shes byed mi snang zhing*/ zhi ba'i las la sgra bya 'gugs pa'i lha pho mo bsgoms pa dang des dgug bya mi 'gugs pa 'gal bas mi 'thad do// man snyer/ rten lhar bskyed nas sgrub bya'i rnam shes 'gugs pa mdzad kyang*/

nag po zhabs dang ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes rnam shes bcug nas lhar bskyed par mdzad pa ltar 'thad do/ /'on kyang 'di dang rnam shes 'gugs pa'i sngon du ro la bsangs sbyangs bsdus pa dang*/ yi ge ṇi las gshin po rang nyid kyi tha mal pa'i gzugs su bskyed chog byas shing*/ mkhas pa dag gis de yang rung bar gsungs mod kyi/ rang lus ngo shes nas rnam shes 'jug sla ba la sogs pa'i dgos pa yod pas/ sngon du phal pa'i bskyed chog yod pa 'thad do/ yang bgegs sbyangs ba'i skabs su sngags rnying ma dag gis gshin po gshed ma dang bral ba'i phyir du gshed 'brel du grags pa'i drag las 'tsham ral byed pa la/ 'di dag ni rnying ma'i chos lugs yin no zhes mkhas rlom dag gis sdang smras drag pos 'gog pa ni mi 'thad de/ tshe 'pho ba'i 'gyur ba lung bstan pa'i mdo las| nam mkha' bar snang la gnas pa'i dri za 'chi kha ma'i sems la 'jug pa zhes bya bas/ dri za'i zas btsal ba'i phyir du tshe 'das kyi cha byad bzung nas gtam sna tshogs rgyu mtshan dang bcas te smra ba dang*/ dri za khyab byed ces bya ba dang*| dri za pi tsa na zhes bya ba dang*/ gnod sbyin smra 'dod ces bya ba dang*/ gnod sbyin wa ra hin+ta kun tu rtogs 'dod ces bya bas tshe 'das kyi cha byas bzung nas nye 'brel la gnod pa sna tshogs byed pa dang*/ yi dwags gshin rje'i chad pa zhes bya bas tshe 'das lag pa bcings te/ lha mi'i 'jig rten nas yi dwags sam gshin rje'i 'jig rten du 'khrid pa dang*/ gzhan yang tshe 'das skye ba blang pa'i gnas su gnod pa sna tshogs byed pa'i bgegs rigs yod par gsungs pa sogs kyi gdon bgegs sbyangs ba'i ched du khro bo spyan 'dren dang drag sngags sogs dang*/ grub na drag po'i sbyin bsregs byed par gsungs pa rnams dang rang gis kyang gang 'grub lag len du byed pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro| |de nas sems lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos lus khro bo'i gar 'chams dang stang stabs|

ngag drag sngags kyi nga ro sogs byed pa ni 'thad la/ /de'i tshe nye 'brel gyi ngu 'bod drag po sogs med mi rung yin par 'dod pa sogs ni log chos 'dres pa yin no/ /slob dpon kun snying gis brab pa dang bkru pa tsam phyir zlog tu bshad kyang*/ bla ma dag skyabs 'gro yang der gzhed gsungs pa ni/ kun snying gis kyang skyabs 'gro phyir zlog tu byed pa ma bkag pas der bzhed par gsal lo| |dbang bskur tshar nas lam sbyang bstan byed pa la nag po pas sbyang ba sngon dang*/ gtsug dgu dang ting nge 'dzin rdo rje bstan pa sngon du bshad pa gnyis ni ming 'dogs mi mthun pa tsam du zad do/ /'on kyang sbyang ba ni tshe 'das rang rgyud kyi lam lnga po bar do'i rten de la cho ga khyad par can gyi mthus 'gro pa'i mos pa dang ting nge 'dzin bsgom du 'jug pa yin la/ bstan pa ni/ dag pa'i zhing du 'gro ba'i 'gro sa bstan nas der song shig ces ston pa yin no/ des na mkhas pa dag gis/ sbyong ba'i sngags su/ gtsig dgu'i oṃ pad me pad me pad mod bha we su kha wa ti gats+tshan+tu swāhā/ zhes pa sbyar ba ni 'thad par ma mthong ngo*// zad gtad ces grags pa la/ slob dpon gyi ting nge 'dzin gy-is ma bsngos pa'i 'jig rten phal pas zas gos mang pos tshe 'das la dmigs nas rang dgar gtong pa dang*/ de des thob cing bskal ba'i bar du longs spyod par mthong ba sogs ni sngar bshad pa'i 'byung po rnams kyis de ltar ston par mdo las gsungs pa ltar yin la/ slob dpon gyis byin gyis brlabs nas bsngo ba'i dus la/ kha cig lam sbyang bstan gyi staun rnam shes ma yar zhing lhar gsal ba'i dus su nges par dgos kyi/ gnas spar bar grags ba'i rjes su mi thob bo zhes smra ba ni mi rigs te/ dag pa'i zhing nas slar slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor dang lus la mchod pa byed du 'ongs pa'i tshe yang thob pa'i phyir ro/

/de bzhin du ro'am ming byang sreg pa yang*/ khag cig rnam shes gshegs gsol byas nas bsreg dgos te de lta ma yin na lha bsregs pa'i nyes pa 'byung ngo zhes zer la/ kha cig /de lta na/ gson gcig dgongs shig zer ba mi 'thad cing*/ lha ni mes bsreg par yang mi nus te sbyin bsreg gi lha bzhin no/ /des na bla ma'i gdung bzhu ba'i tshe chos 'brel med pa btsal nas me snod du 'jug pa sogs kyang blun po'i rnam thar yin zhes smra'o/ /gnyis ka mi 'thad de/ rnam shes ye shes gnyis su byas pa'i rnam shes ni glo bur dri ma'i chos/ /nges par sbyang bya dang sbyin bsregs kyi tshe yang nges par bsreg bya yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rnam shes gshegs gsol byas rting phung po lnga dang rnam shes brgyad la sogs pa med pa'i phyir dang*/ /dri ma'i chos de dag mes bsregs pa yang nus pa'i phyir ro/ /des na tshe 'das kyi shin du phra ba'i rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i 'ja' lus ye shes kyi sku gshegs su gsol ste bar snang du bzhag la/ dri ma'i chos phung khams skye mched thams cad ro'i ming byang dang lhan cig bsregs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du bla ma'i ye shes kyi sku la me'i gnod pa me lha 'am mchod yul du byed mod kyi/ sprul sku 'byung lus kyi sku gdung ni bud shing gi tshul du bya bar rigs la/ 'on kyang bla ma'i gdung yin pas gzhig par dka' ba dang 'jig rten tha snyad dang bstun nas chos 'brel med pa dang phal pa la'ang sha rus mi gcig pa la sogs pa btsal bar bya ba yin te sprul sku'i lam 'khyer gyi mdo sngags thams cad 'jig rten snang ngo dang nges par bstun nas gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di la bod kyi mkhas pas bla ma'i gdung gzhu kar lha la gshegs gsol ma byas na mchod rten gshegs pa'i 'tshams med du 'gyur bar/ rdo rje gur gyi 'grel ba slob dpon lha'i rigs kyi blo gros kyis mdzad pa dang de'i rjes 'brang gi rgya gzhung las 'byung ba gnyis khungs su rgya cher drangs nas/

rang lugs la 'di ro mchod yul gyi tshul du bsregs pa yin no/ /zhes gsung pa'ang cung zad 'gal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyud dang rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung nas 'byung ba'i lho sgo'i cho ga rnams bsdu na/ gang zag dman pa'i dang*/ mchog gi dbang du byas pa gnyis| dang po la bgegs dang*/ /sdig pa sbyang ba gnyis phyi ma la/ phyir zlog byas te dang*/ dbang bskur ste dang*/ sngags bzlas ste dang*/ mchod rten du bzhag ste dang*/ 'chad pa'am khang par bzhag ste dang*/ sbyon bsreg byas ste dang*/ rus pa ri'am chu la dor ste dang*/ tsha tsha btab ste sdig pa sbyang ba ste sdig sbyong brgyad gsungs te/ de la dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bris byas la| gshin la gson bzhin dbang bskur na/ /ngan song gnas su skyes na yang*/ /de nyid grol bar the tshom med/ /'on te ming ngam gzugs brnyen la/ / de ltar rab tu gnas byas te/ /mchod rten nang du gzhug byas na/ /de yi bsod nams bsam mi khyab/ /ces dang*/ sku gsung thugs dang ye shes kyis*/ / sngags kyi mtshan ma bsdus byas la/ /thal ba rus pa'i drir bcas rnams/ /rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bor dor/ /yang na rang ming ldan pa yi/ /sngags bzlas lha yi gzugs nyid dam/ /mchod rten gzugs su byas na ni/ /de nyid sdig pa rnams las grol/ /zhes pas dbang bskur ba dang*/ mchod rten nang du bzhag pa dang*/ /chu bor dor ba dang*/ sku gzugs dang tsha tshar gdab pa rnams dngos su bstan to/ /'dis ni/ skye bo phal pa'i rus pa sogs mchod rten du gzhug pa dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten du byas nas mchod gral du bzhag na/ gang zag dam pa dang bsod nams can gyis phyag mchod byas pas de la :bsnan

[ gnod ] pa 'gro ste/ 'od bsrung rdzogs byed kyi mchod rten bzhin no/ /zhes smra ba bkag ste/ rus chog dbang bskur lhar bsgyur chog rgyas par byas na de la mi gnod de/ dam pa rnams ni rdo shing las sku gzugs su grub tsam la'ang phyag mchod bya bar gsung pa bzhin mdzad la/ bsod nams can gyi tshangs pa brgya byin sogs ni/ dkyil 'khor mthong ba dang sngags 'dzin pa dang mtshan 'dzin pa tsam la'ang bsrung skyob dang phyag mchod byed pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang 'od bsrungs rdzogs byed kyi mchod rten ltar rang gis lhar bsgom pa dang ye shes gzhug pa sogs kyang byed ma myong*/ slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pas rus chog khyad par can dang lhar bskyed pa sogs gang yang ma byas na ni de ltar 'gyur bas 'dul ba lung du yang sdig can gyi mchod rten bkag pa yin gyis/ spyir ni so skye la mchod rten byi bo bya bar gsungs so/ /ro la snyen pa byed par ni/ nag po pa'i gshin rje gshed kyi ro bsregs las/ /dang por ro la khrus byas nas/ /bsrung ba'i cho ga rdzogs pa dang*/ /phyi yi gtor ma btang bar bya/ /de nas tshogs bsags nas bzung ste/ /mngon pa rtogs pa rdzogs pa dang*/ / bzang po'i khri la bzhag nas kyang*/ /rgyan gyis legs par spras pa la/ /ga bur la sogs khar blug nas/ /bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab bya ste/ /snying khar gzungs thag btags nas kyang*/ /rtsa ba'i sngags la de nyid gsum/ /spel ba'i bzlas pa khri tsam bya/ /zhes dang*/ sā dhu pu tras kyang slob dpon gyis grangs kyi bsnyen pa bya'o/ /zhes so/ /dbang gi sngon du sta gon nam dngos gzhi'i tshe yang rung ste/ bgegs byang ba'i thog mar ji ltar bya ba ni/ bram ze nag po zhabs kyi kyai rdor ro bsregs las/ ro lhag par gnas pa ni/ khrus bya dri zhim po dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi lngas byug rnam shes dgug pa sngon du 'gro bas rang gi lhar bskyed la sdig pa bshags pa nas sems bskyed pa'i bar du bya'o/

/zhes dang*/ ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes| snying kha'i sa bon las ni grub pa bzang*/ 'khor los mtshan pa'i lcags kyu spros byas te/ /de yi gshin po 'jig rten pha rol sogs/ / sems ni mdog dmar gsal ba dgug bya ste/ /chos kyi sgo mo'i gzugs sam yang na ni/ /rlung med mar me mi g.yo lta bu'o/ /'ongs nas 'di yi shes pa snying khar ni/ /ro yi spyi bo nas ni gzhug par bya/ /de ni shes pa dang ni yang dag ldan| |de rjes langs nas 'dug par blta bar bya/ /de snying mo ha ra ti bkod nas ni/ zhes sogs spyan mar bskyed tshul dang bcas pa gsungs so/ /bgegs sbyang gi skabs su drag las dgod pa yang*/ /de yi lus can sdig sogs dang*/ bgegs rnams gzhom par bya ba'i phyir/ /gos nag bgo zhing khros nas kyang*/ / 'jig rten gsum bdag nyid du bsgyur/ /zhes so/ /sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ sgrub bya'i rkang pa dag la ni/ /gzhu yi rnam 'dra'i dkyil 'khor te/ /lte bar ye shes yang dag 'bar/ /de yi snying khar sbar ba yis/ /'od zer 'bar ba kun du 'khrigs/ /paṃ gyur sdig pa mi bzad pa| |sna yi sgo nas phyung nas ni/ /de nas khro bo'i gzugs bsgoms te/ /kun tu bzod par bsgom par bya/ zhes so/ /'di ni rdzas gcig pa'i sbyin bsregs ces bya ste skabs gzhan du yang bzang ngo*/ /de bzhin du/ /gtsug dgu'i rgyud las/ de nas phyir zlog bya ba ni/ /yung kar gyis ni bya ba yin/ /rus pa'am gos sam ming la na/ /de rjes chu yis bkru bar bya/ /sdig pa bkru ba'i sngags kyis ni/ /srid gsum dri ma bkru bar bya/ /zhes so/ /de yang las sgrib rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs las/ paṃ'am til lam yung kar ram chu gang yang rung ba la bzlas brjod bya ste rus pa'am shi ba'i lus la gtor ram/ khrus byas nas bsregs pa'am 'chang ba'i nang du bcug ste bzhag la/ rigs sngags kyang bris te mgo la btags na/

de ngan song du skyes pa yang gdon mi za bar zhag 'dun gyis thar te bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas/ kak+ṇi dang rnam rgyal gyi gzungs las/ sems can sdig pa byas pa gang dag 'chi ba'i dus byas pa de dag gi don du gzungs pa'i yungs kar la lan nyi shu rtsagacig yongs su brjod de/ de dag gi rus gong rnams kyi steng du gtor na/ de dag sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa ngan song rnams su skye par gyur kyang rung ste gzungs 'di'i mthus ngan 'gro de dag las thar nas lhar skye bar 'gyur ro zhes dang dri med las/ bye ma la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas te dur khrod du gtor na gang gi rus pa la phog pa de dag sems can dmyal ba gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang de las yongs su thar te mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur ro/ / skyes pa de dag la me tog gi char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang*/ don zhags cho ga zhib mo las/ oṃ pad+moṣ+ṇi ṣa bi mā le hūm̐ phaṭa/ sems can gang dag sems can dmyal bar gzhol ba shi ba dang*/ dge slong gang la'ang bslab pa'i sdom pa 'chal ba dang*/ mkhan po slob dpon la gus par ma byas pa shi ba de'i don du bye ma gtsang ma blangs la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas nas dur khrod dam ro bsregs pa'am 'chad pa der bye ma de gtor bar bya'o/ /gang du gtor ma thag tu rus pa la bye ma babs pa'i sems can de dmyal ba'am yi dwags sam/ sha za'am gnod sbyin nam srin po'i skye gnas su skyes pa de de'i mod la tshe brjes nas mtho ris su gzhol bar 'gyur zhing nam yang sems can dmyal bar gzhol bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs dang*/ gtso bor sbyong rgyud las rgyas par gsungs so/ khrus chu'i rdzas dang sngags so so ni/ gtsug dgu las/ shi ba'i rus pa gos la rab bkru ba/ oṃ sho dha ni zhes sogs sngags kyis ni/ srid gsum dri ma chu yis bkru bar bya/

/oṃ kaṃ ka ni zhes sogs sngags kyis ni/ ba yi rnam pa lnga yis bkru bar bya/ /oṃ rat+ne rata zhes sogs sngags kyis ni/ dri bzang rnams ni kun gyis bkru bar bya/ oṃ a mo gha ā wa ra ṇa swa/ sngags kyis ba yi 'o ma'i bkru bar bya/ oṃ a mi te a mi te zhes so/ sngags kyi chu mchog gis kyang bkru bar bya/ /oṃ puṇ+yai sogs pa'i sngags kyis ni/ bar dang bar du chu yis bkru bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rigs lnga'i go rims ni rang rang gi dkyil 'khor bzhin byed kyang rung ngo*/ /dbang bskur dngos la/ gzhan rnams mi gsal zhing*/ sā dhu ḍu tras dbang bdun tsam/ las ma bshad bla ma rnams tshe 'das sngar dbang bzhi thob pa'i dam tshig can yin na dang po nas tshang ma/ gzhan du na bum dbang ngam chu dbang gsum bzhi song nas bzhi ka bskur gsung*/ lam sbyang bstan gyi tshig bla ma rnams gzhan dag brjod par mdzad mod kyi/ nag :po [ pos ] kyai rdor ro bsreg las 'byung ba lag len la brjod par bya'o/ /slob dpon 'dis rnam shes a thung gi rnam pa rlung gis btegs nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i gtso bo'i thugs kar stim pa bshad/ bde gshegs gnas 'god las/ ku sha'i rtse mor rdo rje rtse gcig bsgom pa'i sbubs nang gnas pa'i me 'od rlung gis bskyod nas ro'i snying kha'i rnam shes la phog pas spyi gtsug nas 'thon ste sangs rgyas pa'am/ bde ba can sogs dag pa'i zhing du pad+ma la rdzus te skyes par bsam/ sgo gzhan nas 'thon na 'pho ba dang 'dra ba 'gro ba ngan par 'gro ste/ de yang 'tshogs ma/ mdzod pu/ mig /rna ba/ sna/ kha/ lte ba/ khu lam/ chu lam/ bshang lam rnams rim pa bzhin gzugs med/ gzugs/ mi lha/ gnod sbyin/ dri za/ 'dod lha/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro/ dmyal ba'o/ /mthar yang rten gyi mdun du zhi ba'i sbyin bsregs bya bar bshad do/ /de phan chad grub na zhag bdun gyi bar du'ang thun bzhi la sogs par bya dgos te/

de ltar zhag ni gnyis gsum nas| |zhag brgyad pa yi bar du bya/ zhes dang*/ zhag bdun du dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dbang bskur na zhes :sbyod [ sbyong ] rgyud las gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ mchod rten du bzhag par ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de nas rnal 'byor can gyis ni/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas de dbang bskur/ /lha yi gzugs su brtags nas kyang*/ /mchod rten dbus su bzhag par bya/ /zhes dang*| rgyal ba'i lhas mchod rten gyi rmang du gshin gson gyi sdig sgrib bar chad kyi ming bris pa mnan pa bcug / ro'am rus pa bkrus pa'i chus 'jim pa sbrus nas mchod rten brtsigs pa'i bum par ro bzhag rten bskyed pa nas dbang bskur mchod rten gyi bar byas pa mchod rten grub nas rab gnas dga' ston rgya cher bya bar bshad/ mchad pa 'am khyim du bzhag par ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ rang gi lha'am lha gzhan gyi/ /snying po snying khar bris nas ni/ /lha 'dra bar ni sems bskyed de/ khyim gyi nang du bzhag par bya/ /zhes dang dza ma de bas/ gser dngul lam shing gi sgrom mam/ sa'i bang bu/ rab byung la mchod rten dkar po/ dge bsnyen la pad+ma dmar po kha sbyar/ rgyal po la sngon po gtsug tor lta bu/ slob dpon la dmar skya za ma tog lta bu/ tha mal pa pho la ser skya gdan khri lta bu/ mo la sngo skya bil ba'i 'bras bu/ byis pa la dmar ser lhung bzed lta bu rnams byas pa'i nang du ro mgo nub dang kha lhor bstan pa'i lag pa spyi bor thal mo sbyar/ de la srad bu dmar po btags pa snod nas gtor te/ nub dngos kyi thog la gdags/ steng du gdugs khra'o phub/ dbang bskur mchod bstod gyi bar rgyas par byas/ /phyogs bzhir rin chen sna bdun gyi gzugs dang mchod rdzas du mas bskor ba byin gyis brlab pa nas rgyun du mchod par bshad do/ /ro bsregs pa la/ nag po zhabs kyis/ bsgrubs te dang*/ dur khraud du bsreg pa gnyis bshad pa'i dang po ni/

ro'i lus kyi cha shas dam tshig gi rdzas so drug tu gnas pa byin gyis brlabs nas rtog pa med pa rnams kyis dngos su rol ba'i nang gyi sbyin bsreg go / gnyis pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ ro la sngags kyis btab nas kyang*/ /chu mchog gis ni bkrus nas su// bzlas pa'i dri yis byug par bya/ /gos dang rgyan gyis bklubs nas kyang*/ /sngags kyis btab pa'i gdug pas bdug /me tog phreng ba la sogs mchod/ /gtsug phud dpung par de bzhin du/ /sngags bris nas ni gdags par bya/ snying kha lkog ma kha phyogs su/ /sarba bid kyis byin gyis brlab/ /dpra ba mdzod pu rna ba gnyis/ /mgo bo gtsug tor dpung pa gnyis| |sna dang sked pa dpus mo bol/ /long bo sna yi rtse mo dang*/ /mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba yi/ /dbang po rnams kyi gnas la ni/ /de ltar gzhan du yi ge sngags/ /mchog tu dge ba rnams bzhag go /de nas ngan song sbyang ba'i phyir/ /bstan dang bcas ste de dbus su/ /bzhag pa nyid du bya ba yin/ /de nas sngags 'chang sngags kyis ni/ /btab pa'i gos kyis g.yog par bya/ /zhes sogs dang*/ /dkyil chog rin chen 'bar ba las/ /rdo rje sdom pa byin nas kyang*| |bum pa'i dbang ni sbyin par bya/ /mig la sogs la gti mug sogs/ / rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum dgod/ /rdo rje thab khung rab sbyor bas/ /sbyin bsreg rims pas sbyang bar bya/ /zhes bshad cing ār+ya de bas/ bsrung skud byin brlabs tshul bzhin bya/ /bde gshegs sa bon rnams kyang dgod/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas rang rang gi /lus kyi lam bskyed mkhyed kyi lha'i sngags kyi gdags yig rgyas par bya'o/ /'di dag ni ro mi bsreg kyang bya la/ dur khrod sogs su 'khyer ba la/ bde gshegs gnas 'god las/ ro 'khyer mkhan rnams bsags te/ yi ge gsum bzlas pa'i bsrung skud gdags/ de nas gdugs/ rnga yab/ ral gri/ bum pa/ dgang blug bza' bca'/ ba dan rnams thogs pa rim pa bzhin/

brgya byin tshangs pa/ khyab 'jug chu lha/ me lha/ bden bral| rlung lha/ bstod pa 'don mkhan bde byed/ ro las sa gshin rje rnams lhag par mos pa'am rgyas par bskyed/ yig brgya tshar bdun bzlas/ dge rtsa bsngos te langs la/ slob dpon gyis spyan ma'i sngags dang dur ga ti bzla zhing sngon la 'gro/ ro btegs te rol cha sna tshogs dang sbyar lha rnams kyis kyang mchod par bsam te 'gro bar bshad pa bzhin kri ya sa muts+tsha sogs nas kyang bshad do/ /ro bsregs pa la/ sbyin bsregs rgyas bsdus dang sbyar bar kun las gsungs la/ dri med 'grel par/ bdun khrag gi rjes su sbyin bsregs bya ste| de yang lha'i grong khyer du bsams nas bsregs rdzas kyis mchod pa'am/ yang na/ thab tu lha'i dkyil 'khor bsams nas ro zhal zas su byin gyis brlabs te bsregs la zhes bshad cing*/ kun snying gis/ /shog gu'am ras la pad ma dkar po 'dab brgyad lte bar pad ma'am 'khor los mtshan pa ro'i gdan du 'dings pa sogs bshad/ gson gcig dgongs shing sogs ni/ nag po zhabs kyi kyai rdor ro bsregs las bshad/ sngags bzlas te sdig pa sbyang bar ni| sbyong rgyud las/ de yi ming nas brjod nas ni/ /de ltar gsungs pa'i sngags bzlas shing*/ /'bum phrag stong ngam yang na ni/ /brgya phrag stong du tshang ba dang*| |bye ba stong du rab bzlas na*/ /lha yi gnas su nges par skye/ /zhes so/ / sbyin bsregs kyang*/ de las/ de yi ming nas smos nas kyang*/ /sngags pas 'bum phrag brgya'am ni/ /yang na brgya phrag stong snyed du/ /sbyin bsregs byas par gyur na ni/ /dmyal ba chen por 'gyur ba yi// sdig pa de las thar par 'gyur/ zhes so/ /rus pa ri'am chu la dor bar ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ /thal ba'i yung kar bye ma sogs/ /rang gi ming smos sngags btab nas/ bzlas pa byas te song nas kyang*/ /rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i glong du dor| |de lta na ni sdig can yang*/

ngan song las ni thar 'gyur na/ /zhes dang*/ bde gshegs gnas 'god las/ de rjes rus pa rnams sbyangs ba/ zhib mor rdo la btags nas ni/ /shin tu rgya che'i chu bo la/ /mchod pa byas te bskur bar bya| |yang na sa 'dzin chen po ni/ / mthon po'i rtse la 'dzegs nas su/ /shin tu shugs drag mthun pa yi/ /rlung de la ni bskur bar bya zhes so/ /tsha tsha gdab pa ni sbyong rgyud las/ /de nas thal bar gyur pa dang*/ /rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags kyis ni/ /cho ga bzhin du bsdu bar bya/ / thal ba de dang rus pa rdul/ sngags kyis btab pa'i dri chu dang*/ /ba skyes 'o ma la sogs lngas/ /sbyong ba'i sngags kyis blo ldan gyis/ 'bum du bzlas pas rdzis nas ni/ /ga bur dri yi bgos pa yis// 'jim pa dang yang bsres nas kyang*| |gzugs su bya ba'am yang ni ni/ /mchod rten gyi ni lhar byas la/ / gcig gam gnyis sam gsum mam lnga/ /yang na brgya rtsa brgyad du bya/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas btab nas su/ /'bum phrag nyi brgya'i bar du bzlas/ /de nas mchod rten 'bar gyur te/ /yang na gzugs kyi zhal 'dzum mam/ /dri dang bdug pa'i 'od kyang rung*/ /snang ngam yang na ngad ldang ngam/ sogs nas ces ste mtshan ma 'di dag ni/ sdig can blos ni ma mthong ba/ 'bum gyi phrag ni brgyad stong ngam| |ji srid mtshan ma byung bar du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchod nas ni/ / mnyam par bzhag nas bzlas pa bya/ /de yi mthar ni mkhas pas kyang*/ /mtshan gcig thog mtha' mi nyal bzlas/ /de las de yi sdig pa ni/ /dag pa nyid du nges par mthong*/ /zhes sogs/ mi 'khrugs pa las kyang*| mchod rten 'bum phrag byas nas chu klung du dor ba'am/ gzhi mdor mchod rten tshul bzhin byas na ngan song las thar te bde 'gro phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba rgya cher gsungs so| |gal te ro med na'ang dbang bskur bar ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ de yi gzugs brnyan bris pa'am/ /gur gum gyis ni ming yang rung*/

/ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal las/ /sems can rnams ni grol bya'i phyir/ /sngags mkhan gzhan la phan brtson zhing*/ /snying rje can gyis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes sogs| |skye ba blangs tshar nas kyang dbang bskur bya ba ni/ de las kye'i lha'i bu rnams ngan song du skyes zin pa gang yin pa rnams la yang ming la yang dbang bskur cig /gzugs brnyan la dbang bskur cig /mchog rten dang de rang gi lha'i sku la yang dbang bskur cig /chung ngu na der rigs mthun pa dang de'i ming 'dzin pa dang bran la'ang dbang bskur cig zhag bdun du dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dbang bskur na gdon mi za bar ngan song gi sgrib pa las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar sgo du ma nas sdig pa sbyang bas mtho ris su skyes pa'i mtshan la ni/ de las/ de nas de ni nges par yang*| |lha yi gnas su skyes gyur nas/ /de yi mtshan ma ston byed de/ /yang na lha'i mchog tu 'ong*/ /yang na hoṃ khung nang du ni/ /me yi ltas kyis ston byed de/ dkar po nyid de g.yas su 'bar/ /gyen du 'bar zhing dri ma med/ /zlum zhing rnam par mi 'phro la| |brtan la dri bzang klog lta bu/ /zhes sogs gsungs so bde 'gror skyes bar shes nas kyang tshe dang longs spyod sogs rgyas pa'i phyir du rgyas pa dang*/ gzhan dbang du 'gyur ba'i phyir du dbang dang*/ der bgegs med par bya ba'i phyir du/ mngon spyod kyi sbyin bsreg bya bar yang sbyong rgyud der gsungs so/ /gang zag mchog la ji ltar bya ba ni/ /gur gyi bco lnga pa las/ slob dpon mthar byed dus na ni/ /'jig rten pa ni shi zhes rol/ /rmongs ldan mi rnams gang zer ba| |shi ba zhes pa rmongs pa'o/ /zhes nas/ rdo rje dril bu lag par sbyin/ /mgo bo dbu brgyan bskon par bya/ /rdo rje sdom pa rnos sbyin te/ /bum pa'i dbang bskur rnams sbyin la/ /mig sogs gti mug rdo rje sogs/

/rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum mo/ /rdo rje thab khung rab sbyor gyi/ /'du byed rab tu brtan pa bya/ / nyi ma gsum ni lon pa ni/ /rus pa'i phreng ba bsdu byas la/ /dri dang 'o las brabs nas ni/ /de yis mchod rten du bya'o/ /zhes dang*/ ta thā ga ta ra k+ṣi tas/ rdo rje slob dpon 'ga' zhig ni/ /shi ste ro ru gyur nas kyang*/ / mchod pa yang dag sngon 'gro 'dis/ /dur khrod du ni gzhug par bya/ de las sngags pas sa yi ni| |dag byed sngags kyis 'dus byas te/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag bri bar bya// de yi gtso bo de nyid kyis/ /dbang bskur lnga ni sbyin par bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur yang*/ /phyi na cho ga mkhas pas sbyin/ /me tog spos la sogs pas mchod| |yang dag mchod cing bstod par bya/ /zhes sogs las rgyas par rtogs par bya ste shis byed rgyas par rgyud dang rgya gzhung de dag tu blta bar bya'o// da ni de dag lag len du byed tshul 'jug pa bde zhing ma tshang ba med par brjod par bya ba yang gang zag dman mchog /dang po la bsnyen pa dang las la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po la/ rab ro dngos sam med na rten la'ang rung ste/ dkyil 'khor so so'i skye mched dang lus dkyil gyi lha 'god pa'i gnas dang ma mtha' rdo rje gsum mam bzhi'i gnas dang*/ dus 'khor la rgyas par na/ lha so so'i nyer bsdu'i gnas so so rnams su lha de dang de'i mtshan sngags sam/ ma grub na sa bon gyi haṃ sogs kyis bris pa rnams khrus sngon du btang nas legs par sbyar ba dngos sam/ mos pa bya/ ro'i khar ga pur la sogs pa dri bzang po'i chu blug lus la'ang byugs/ khri bzang po'i steng du bzhag skya btsun rang rang gi gos bzang pa bkon/ mchod pa bsham/ de'i mdun du bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus ci ltar 'grub pa sngon du bya/ bgegs gtor btang*/ bgegs bskrad/ bsangs sbyangs/ ṇi las gson po'i gzugs su bskyed/

steng du spyan ma bsgoms pa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas ro yi dri ma sbyangs nas sa 'og tu song nas lus shel ltar gyur par mos shing*/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sarba ar+tha sā dha na swā hā/ zhes brgya tsam bzla/ dkyil 'khor gzhan la spyan ma'i 'od zer ram| dus 'khor la zhi ba'i las kyi sgrub bya 'gugs pa'i lha'i bu dkar po mtshan nyid dang ldan pas tshe 'das kyi rnam shes gtad 'dug nas bkug par mos shing de 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya dang bden stobs brjod pas bkug la ro'am rten la bcug pa'i rjes su pho yin na rnam snang dang mo yin na spyan mar bskyed pa'am/ yang na gtso bor bskyed yan lag bzhi rdzogs byas pa'i dpral ba'am snying khar chu'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du pad dkar dang zla ba la gnas pa'i lha'i bu dkar po g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon pad dkar/ lha mo dkar mo g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon ud pa la dkar po 'dzin pa gnyis ka pad ma'i 'dug stangs can rim bzhin pho mo la dgod/ rang gi snying kha'am dpral bar yang de ltar bsams pas sdig sgrib zhi ba'i las la brtson par mos bzhin pas mchod bstod sdus pa bya snying rje dang lhag bsam legs par bskyed/ rten la gzungs thag btags la/ rnam snang spyan ma'am gtso bo'i phreng sngags sam snying po bzhi khri'i bar du bzlas te/ thun mtshams su mchod bstod dang rdzas gcig pa'i sbyin bsregs kyang bya'o/ /'di ni shi ba'i rus pa sogs la'ang sbyar rung bas sngags bzlas te sdig pa sbyang ba'am 'di la bsdur rung bas na kak+ṇi dur ga sogs kyang bzlas nas gdab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la sdig sbyong lhag ma bdun las/ phyir zlog ni sbyor ba dang*/ dbang bskur ni dngos gzhi dang*/ mchod rten du bzhag pa/ khyim dang 'chad par bzhag pa/ ro bsregs pa/ rus pa ri rtse'am chu bor dor ba/ tsha tsha gdab pas sdig pa sbyang ba ste lnga ni mjug chog tu gtogs so/

/des na dang po phyir zlog gi sdig pa sbyang ba la rten sbyangs bkru gsol la/ dang po rten bskyed pa ni/ sa chog rgyas sdus dang sta gon gzhan rnams tshar nas/ slob ma sta gon gyi tshe/ ro'am ming byang sogs kyi rten bsangs sbyang stong pa'i ngang las yi ge ṇi'am ming yig dang po yongs su gyur pa las/ tshe 'das che ge mo'i gson dus kyi mdog dbyibs lus sems rgyan gos ji bzhin du gnas par gyur rang nyid gtso bor gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ ngam dza:las lcags kyu dzaḥs mtshan pa las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas tshe 'das kyi rnam shes bkug par bsam zhing rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings nas mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ba cung zad bskum nas lcags kyu ltar byas pa gsang ba'i lcags kyu'i phyag rgya las mtheb chung gnyis khab ltar brkyang ba rten gyi mgor bzhag /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ dzaḥ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun gyi dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs khyad par cho ga gang byed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi/ mthu ldan dam pa chos skyong bsrungs ma rdau rje ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi khyad par du yang shi ba'i rnam par shes pa 'gugs pa'i snying po dang phyag rgya 'di'i bden pas| 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du song zhing tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i rnam par shes pa srid pa bar do khams gsum rigs drug skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i cha gang nas kyang skad cig yud tsam thang cig la 'dir mchis te/ a thung gi gzugs sam mar me ltar gsal ba'i rnam pas spyi bo nas zhugs te snying khar thim par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a ku sha dzaḥ'am bhai ra wa a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ de nas rdo rje khur tshur gnyis kyi nang du 'dzub mo gnyis lcags sgrogs ltar bcing nas legs par gyen du 'phang ba lhung ba slong ba'i phyag rgya dang*/

oṃ sarba a pā ya a kar+ṣa na bu shwa dha na badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa| slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ngan song gsum po thams cad bkug nas dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du gnas pa rnams kyang snying rje'i 'od zer gyis bkug ste de'i snying khar thim pa'i rkyen gyis rten stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pho rnam snang dang mo spyan mar cho ga gsum mam skad cig gis bskyed| ye shes pa bcug dbang bskur rgyas gdab bsdus pa bya/ rdo rje gsum mam rigs drug dang yan lag drug dgod do/ / sbyang ba la bgegs dang sdig pa dang*/ dri ma sbyang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ zhi ba dang*/ zhi drag phyed ma dang drag po'i sbyang bar grags pa'i bsham bsngo ltar ram| yang na bgegs gtor gcig kyang rung ste/ spyi 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang nyid rdo rje shugs sam so so'i gtso bo'i hūm̐ mdzad du gsal bas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ bden stobs snga ma bzhin las/ shi ba'i rnam shes 'gugs pa'i zhes sogs bzhag nas/ bden pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs kyis deng 'dir tshe las 'das pa 'di zhes bya ba gson gyi dus tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod pa/ shi nas mtho ris kyi lus rten khyad par can 'dzin pa la bar du gcod pa/ bde 'gro'i longs spyod myong ba dang mtho ris dang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa/ tshe las 'das pa'i lus kyi cha byad bzung nas 'brel ba shul na gnas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar sems pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang dri za 'chi kha ma'i yid la nye bar 'jug pa zhes bya ba dang*/ dri za khyab ces bya ba dang dri za tsa na zhes bya ba dang*/ gnod sbyin drag 'dod zhes bya ba'i rigs dang*/ gnod sbyin wa ra hi ta kun tu rtogs 'dod ces bya ba'i rigs su gtogs pa'i gdon bgegs 'byung po ci mchis pa thams cad skad cig yud tsam cig la gtor ma 'di'i mgron du mchis par gyur cig ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥbadz+ra bhi ra wa ya a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥsarba bigh+nan na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tha khaṃ ud ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ grih+ṇa na ba liṃ dā ya swā hā/

gsum a kā ros bsngos nas tshim par bsams la/ slar yang spro na khro bo spyan 'dren mchod bstod dang bcas te bden stobs snga ma brjaud nas ci mchis pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di nyid kyis tshim par gyis la deng phyin chad gnod pa dang gdug pa'i bsam pa thams cad zhi/ phan pa dang zhi ba byang chub kyi sems rin po ches rgyud gang*/ sngon po rdo rje 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar ji ltar khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams dran par gyis la 'dir ma 'dug par rgya mtsho chen po'i mtha' la sogs par song zhigagal te mi 'gro na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po me rab tu 'bar ba rnams kyis mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing lus dum du stong du 'gems par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥsogs bgegs bsreg pa'i sngags dang drag sngags mang du brjod/ yungs dkar gyis brab/ rol mo drag tu bya/ rang gi lus kyi rdau rje las spros pa'i me 'od kyis bsreg shing bskrad par bsam te/ de yang bgegs kyi rnam smin gyi phung po la sogs pa dri ma'i chos rnams bsregs shing sbyangs nas rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi lus sems 'od gsal gyi dbyings su sangs rgyas par mos pa'i sgo nas rang gi snying rje chen po khro bo'i sku gsung thugs su shar bar mos pas bgegs skrad na ji tsam drag las mang gyin bgegs kyi gdug sems zhi bar 'gyur gyi gzhan du na rang rgyud kyi zhe sdang je cher 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas me chu til gsum bsham/ rten gyi rkang pa'i 'og du yam las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ lte bar gtum mo ye shes kyi me 'bar ba/ snying khar sdig pa'i sa bon sam yig nag po/ de la sgo gsum sdig sgrib thams cad 'dus par gyur/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis rlung g.yos me sbar snying kha'i paṃ yig de nas sna sgor sdig pa rwa can nam sha za'i rnam par 'thon pa til gyi phung po la thim par gyur/

me bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ las byung ba'i ye shes kyi thab mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs par gyur pa'i gnas gsum du 'bru gsum dgod/ ye shes pa zhug dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ mchod bstod/ oṃ badz+ra ḍha ka kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig sogs gang 'grub brjod cing til bsreg /thal ba chur 'dor/ mthar khrau bo mi dmigs pa'am rang gi snying khar bsdu/ 'di ni rdzas gcig pa'i sbyin bsreg ste shin du zab bo/ /gsum pa ni/ bye ma'am yungs kar ram chu la'ang rung te/ dur ga ti dang kak+ṇi dang*/ rnam rgyal dang*/ dri med rgyas pa'am/ oṃ na ma stai pa dhī kā nām/ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya gar+bhe/ dz+wa la dz+wa la dharmā dhā tu gad+bhe/ sahā ra ā yu/ saṃ sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ sarba ta tha ga ta sa man+ta uṣ+ṇi ṣa bi ma le bu shud dhe/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐= aṃ baṃ saṃ dzaḥ swa hā/ zhes pa dag*/ pad+mo uṣ+ṇi ṣa rnams ci 'grub bzla/ khyad par sbyong rgyud las 'byung ba/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha na badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du mgor oṃ dang mthar hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar nas/ sarba karma wa ra ṇa ni bha smin ku ru/ bh+ruṃ bi na shā yā wa ra ṇa ni badz+ra/ druṃ bi sho dha yā wa ra ṇa ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la dha ka dha ka ha na ha nā wa ra ṇa ni/ sruṃ sa ra sa pra sa rā wa ra ṇa ni/ hūm̐ ha ra ha ra sarba ra ṇa ni/ hūm̐ phaṭa sarbā wa ra ṇa ni bu s+pho ṭa ya/ bh+ri ta bri ta dang*/ ṭaḍha ṭa ḍha dang*/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ rnams la sarba wa ra ṇa ni sbyar/ da ha da ha sarba na rang ga ti he tu/ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ga ta te he tu/ ma tha ma tha sarba ti t+yaṃ ka ga ti hi tu/ rnams brjod cing yungs dkar sogs kyis rten nam ming byang la brab par bya'o| |bkru ba la/ khrus chu sgrub pa ni/ bum skyed kyis bsgrubs pa'i chu rnams las bum du bsdu/ rten gsum gang gzhugs la sku khrus legs par gsol ba'i khrus chu yang de blugs so/

/gtsug dgu nas bshad pa'i rigs lnga phyag rdor dang bcas pa'i khrus kyi/ rnam snang dang phyag rdor la chu gtsang*/ mi skyod pa la ba byung lnga| rin 'byung la dri bzang*/ don grub la 'o ma/ 'od dpag med la bdud rtsi bsres pa'i bum pa so so'i gang 'grub bshams la/ rim pa bzhin oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba dur ga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+yā te/ sa myak+saṃ bud dha ya/ tad ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ/ shud dhai bu shud dhe/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ni swa hā/ zhes dang*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni/ tro ṭa ni*/ tro ṭa ni/ tra sa ni/ tra ti ha na/ tra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa raṃ pa ra ṇi me sarba sa twa nam tsa swahā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ rat+ne ma hā rat+ne saṃ bha we/ rat+na mā la bi shud dhe/ sho dha ya sarba hra paṃ hūm̐ traṭa/ ces dang*/ oṃ a mo gha a pra ti ha ta/ sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi nā sha ni/ ha ra ha ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ oṃ a mi ta/ oṃ a mi ta/ a mi tod bha we/ a mi ta saṃ bha we/ a mi ta bi kran+te/ a mi ta bi tran+ta ga mi ni/ sarba karmā kle sha k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ puṇ+yai pu ṇ+yai ma hā pu ṇ+yai a pa ra mi tā yu pu ṇ+yai dz+nya na saṃ bhā ra u pa dza ya ka ri ṇi swā hā rnams mang du bzlas pa sngon nas bum pa sta gon la sogs pa'i skabs su bsgrubs yod na bzang*/ med na'ang skabs 'dir bzlas te sgrubs bo/ /grub nas phyin drug gis bkru ba ni/ jo bos mdzad pa'i mi 'khrugs pa las 'byung ba/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*/ /sbyin pa dri yis legs bgos chu/ khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o/ /dur ga dang*/ gtso bo'i sngags bzla zhing rol mo dang bcas pas me long la rten gyi gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug nas bkru la/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du dus las 'das pa 'di zhes bya ba'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib las ngan thams cad khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa ser sna'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas/

sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /de bzhin phar phyin gzhan la'ang 'don pa spo zhing*/ tshul 'chal dang*/ khong khro dang*/ le lo dang*/ rnam g.yengs dang*/ shes 'chal sbyor ro/ /de nas rigs lngas bkru ba ni/ rnam snang gi bum pa bzung nas/ rnam par snang mdzad ye shes dam pa mtsho chen ldan/ /zla ba nya 'dra'i sku mnga' srid pa mthar byed pa// dgongs pa mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i bkra shis des/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir zhi byed legs gyur cig /durga brjod cing rol mo dang me tog gi char byas la/ khyad par du nyon mongs pa gti mug gi dri ma byang*/ gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes sam/ /gtsug dgu sogs ltar na/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi skur mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /de bzhin du sbyar la mi bskyod pa la/ mi 'khrugs rgyal po srid dang gti mug rnam sbyong ba/ /mgon po yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i bkra shis gang yin dang*/ /dge ba mnyam med rdzogs pa'i bkra shis gang lags pa/ /bkra shis= kak+ṇi/ zhe sdang rnam shes/ chos dbyings/ mi bskyod pa'i/ rin 'byung la/ sangs rgyas yon tan kun gyi rgyan gyis brgyan mdzad cing*/ /yang dag sbyin mdzad 'gro ba'i don la mi bslu ba/ /rin chen 'byung ldan zhes bya'i bkra shis gang lags pa/ /2kra shis/ rar+ṇe sogs ser sna/ tshor ba mnyam nyid/ rin 'byung gi'o/ /don grub la sems can don la thugs ni rab tu dgongs mdzad cing*/ /'gro ba mtha' dag 'ching bas bcings las sgrol mdzad pa/ /thugs mchog don yod grub pa'i bkra shis sogs/ /a mo gha sogs| |phrag dog /'du byed/ bya grub/ don grub kyi'o/ /'od dpag med la/ bsam gtan ting 'dzin dam pa pha rol phyin pa'i gnas/ /ye shes pad ma'i snying zhugs dpag med tshe ldan pa/

/tshe grangs med par byin gyis brlob pa'i bkra shis gang*/ /bkra shis sogs/ a mri te/ 'dod chags/ 'du shes/ sor rtogs| 'od dpag med kyi'o/ /phyag rdo ram rdor sems la/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ kun gyi bdag nyid dam pa'i rigs rnams kyi ni rje/ /ma lus sems can bskyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ bkra shis/ puṇ+yai/ dug lnga phung po lnga/ ye shes lnga/ rigs lnga'o/ /bkru ba'i mthar dug dbyung ni| sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid dang*/ rang rgyal dpa' bo'i gzi brjid dang*| |dgra bcom rnams kyi mthu dag dang*/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa thams cad dang*/ /sha ri'i bu'i shes rab dang*/ /mo 'gal bu yi rdzu 'phrul dang*/ /ma 'gags pa yi mig dang ni/ /'od bsrung sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang*/ /kau de ṇ+ye'i sngar thob dang*/ /kun dga' bo yi thos pa dang*/ /tshangs pa lha yi byams pa dang*// brgya byin gyi ni dbang rnams dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i yul rnams dang*// dbang phyug chen po stobs dang ni/ /sde dpon rnams kyi mthu dag dang*/ /'phrog ma'i gzi brjid rdzu 'phrul dang*/ /de dag rnams kyi mthu dang gzis/ /che po'i dug ni dug med shog /lus rnams 'byed las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum| |'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ /bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'| |sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo/ /chos dang dge 'dun la sbyar/ / gzungs gra lnga las/ sa ni dug gi pha yin te/ sa ni dug gi ma yang yin/ / bden pa'i bden tshig 'di rjod pas/ /dug gsum sa yi nang du song*/ chu me rlung la sbyar/ gang ba'i nang du dug song shig /dur ga spel tshig dang bcas pa rol mo bya'o/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/ /chos ni chos ma yin las rgyal/ /dge 'dun mu stegs rnams las rgyal/ /dbang po lha min rnams las rgyal/ /lha min zla ba rnams las rgyal/ /nam mkha' lding ni rgyal mtsho

las| |chu ni me las rgyal gyur te/ /me ni shing las rnam par rgyal/ /rlung ni sprin las rgyal bar gyur/ /rdo rje yis ni ri chen phug /sa ni bden par gnas pa ste| |lha yang bden par gnas pa yin/ /sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden// bden pas rgyal 'gyur rdzun ma lags/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig de dag gis 'di zhes bya ba nyon mongs pa dug gsum dang des bskyed pa'i brtan g.yo'i dug dang dug las byung ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las rnam par rgyal nas bkra shis par gyur cig /de nas shis rjod bya bar bshad pas/ stong chen rab 'joms nas 'byung ba/ 'jig rten 'di'am yang na 'das pa yi zhes sogs| yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo las/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /rnam bcom dri ma med mdzad pa/ thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ / thar pa'i lam du 'dzud mdzad cing*/ chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ khyed// ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gang gi bde la mnga' mdzad des/ khyed= /skyob pa gang gi byams pa yi/ /thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag skyangs des/ khyed= /gang gi 'khor bar 'gro ba yi/ /sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing*/ /gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des/ khyed= /gang gi chos kun mngon sum gyur/ /gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' ba/ /gsum gtsang gtsang mar gyur pa des/ khyed= /gang gi skyes pas sa rnams ni/ /nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing*/ /sems can thams cad rang dga' des/ khyed=/dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pas/ phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cig /don grub tshogs kyang grub par des/ khyod= /byang chub snying por gshegs pa na/ /sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*/ /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ khyed= /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing*/

/skyob pa'i snyan pa gang byung des/ khyed= /yid 'phrog gang gi mu stegs byed/ /thams cad chos kyi pham mdzad cing*/ tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ /sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*/ / lha rnams kun gyi bsams pa des/ khyod kyi 'dod don gang yin pa'i/ /don de di ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shig /rkang bzhi= khyed cag lam 'gro bde gyur cig /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde bar shog /nyin mo bde legs/ rkang pa tha ma la/ khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /ston mchod dam pa sogs/ /tshangs dang lha dbang*/ 'byung po gang dag sogs brjod par bya'o// gsol ba ni/ de nas tshe 'das dang ngan song pa thams cad kyis mgrin can du// bcom ldan 'das bdag cag sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba 'di las skyabs du gsol| bdag cag rnams sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang khyod la'ang skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes pa de nyid bsdus pa'i rtsa rgyud las 'byung ste/ bsdus pa 'dis 'grub la/ spro na/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ sogs kyi sngon du bla ma yi dam la phyag 'tshal dang bcas pa dang*/ shin tu rgyas pa la spro na/ thugs rje chen po 'phags pa phyan ras gzigs/ dri med dung mdog kyang rung ngo*// gsol gdab de dag nye 'brel yod na dngos su brjod du gzhug /med na tshe 'das kyis brjod par bsams la rang gis brjod/ des na bdag gis zhes pa rnams thad kar bzhag pas chog gis tshe 'das ces sbyar mi dgos/ de nas rdo rje sdams pa las gung mo gnyis bshib ste bsgreng*/ mthe bong gnyis dang mtheb chung gnyis rtse mo sbyar nas phan tshun yang yang 'dral ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba a pā ya ban+dha ni bi mo k+ṣa ya/ sarba a pa ya ga ti bhe/ sarba satwā na sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya tra/ ces brjod/

ngan song gsum gyi sdig pa thams cad bcom zhing dral/ de rnams kyi phyag rgya de mthong bas sdig pa dag ste shi 'phos nas rnam snang gi zhabs drung du skyes/ rten rnams ba tsha can gyi chu bor dor bar gyur to zhes brjod cing bsam mo/ / gnyis pa dbang bskur ni/ de rjes slob ma sta gon gzhan rnams gson po dang 'dra bar bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor bris/ bsgrub mchod bdag 'jug rnams kyang dkyil chog bzhin byas la/ dngos gzhi'i sngon du yang rten bskyed nas sdig pa dral ba 'di'i bar byas te/ maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab nas bzung ste dbang bdun nam/ tshang ma sogs ji ltar rigs pa bskur ba grub nas tshogs 'khor bya zhing tshe 'das la'ang tshogs skal drangs/ mchod bstod byas la/ lam sbyangs ba ni/ tshogs lam smig sgyu lta bu ste/ gnyis pa du ba lta bu'o/ /gsum pa glog tu khyod kyis mthong*/ /bzhi pa mar me lta bu ste/ /lnga pa thams cad stong pa ni| |sangs rgyas pa ni 'di nyid de/ /srid pa bar do 'di nyid du/ khyod kyi lam lnga mthar phyin to/ /oṃ rat+ne sogs brjodame tog gi char dbab/ rol mo bya'o// khyod kyis lam lnga mthar phyin pas/ phung po lnga nyid sangs rgyas lnga/ /nyon mong lnga ni mkha' 'gro lnga/ /rnam shes brgyad ni ye shes bzhi/ /'byung ba bzhi ni lha mo bzhi| |srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de/ / chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor bas| |'khor ba bya ba'i ming yang med/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing sogs| |oṃ pad+me pad+me pad+mo bha we su kha ba ti gats+tshan+tu swā hā/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes gzhom med a thung gi rnam pa de rlung gis bteg nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i gtso bo'i thugs kar thim/ zhes sam/ yang na kun sha'i rtse la rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i sbubs su chug pa'i 'od zer gis tshe las 'das pa'i rnam shes gzhom med snying kha nas bskyed de spyi gtsug nas 'thon te sangs rgyas pa'am bde ba can du song nas pad ma'i sbubs su rdzus te skyes nas rgyal ba 'od dpag med kyis mngon sum du lung bstan thob par gyur to/

/de nas der gnas pa'i byang sems snying po rnams kyis kyang de la mchod/ de ltar gyur pa'i rgyu brtags pas cho ga rnam par dag pa dang rdo rje slob dpon kyi mthur shes nas skad cig de nyid la 'dir 'ongs te/ bla ma yi dam la mchod cing bstod nas/ /e ma sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas/ e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs/ /gang phyir bdag cag ngan song sbyangs/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag /e ma shākya mgon po yi/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa ngo mtshar che/ /gang phyir ngan song ltung ba yi/ /sems can glog bzhin myur du grol/ e ma sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /sngags kyi byin rlabs ya mtshan che/ /gang phyir sems can lhung ba yi/ /sems can lha rnams myur du skyes| |shes ched du brjod par 'gyur/ /de nas ro yod na 'og nas 'chad pa rnams bya zhing*/ med na mig byang bsreg pa ni/ skad cig gi thab dang me 'das ma 'das thams cad dran rdzogs su bskyed la/ tshe 'das kyi phung khams skye mched dri ma'i chos kyis bsdus pa thams cad bsreg rdzas su phul bar mos su bcug pa'i bsam pas/ gson cig dgong shig rigs kyi bu/ / phung po lnga yi bud shing la/ /rgyal ba lnga yi me sbar ro/ /nyon mongs lnga yi= mkha' 'gro lnga yi= rnam shes lnga yi= ye shes lnga yi= 'byung ba bzhi yi bud shing la/ /lha mo bzhi yi me sbar ro/ /oṃ kan+dha dhā tu ā ya tā nāṃ ni swa bha wa dz+wa la dz+wa la ku ru ku ru swā hā/ tshe 'das kyi ye shes kyi lha mchod la me tog gtor zhing*/ oṃ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra gats+tshan+tu swāhā/ slar yang bde ba can la sogs pa dag pa'i zhing khams thams cad du song nas sangs rgyas thams cad la gdams ngag thob ste sangs rgyas par gyur to// dkyil 'khor gtang rag sogs mjug chog ji bzhin byas te/ dngos gzhi de lta bu grub na thun bzhi kar dang ma grub na'ang tha ma la bya ste rgyas par bya ba'o// 'bring du na ro'i bsnyen pa sogs spros pa rgyas pa dor/

bsdu na sta gon yang med par dngos gzhi la gsol btab gyi bar tshang ma dang nang dbang sngon du 'gro ba'i sngags kyi dbang tsam mam/ sngar dbang ma thob pa yin na bum dbang rgyas pa ste/ khrus kyi rigs lnga'i tshigs bcad dam/ bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rdo rje'i rigs dang ldan sogs dang*/ /dkyil 'khor pa'i mtshan sngags gang 'grub dang spel tshig gong bzhin sbyar ba tsam bzhin byas nas mchod bstod lam sbyang bstan man chod bya'o/ / gsum pa la mchod rten du bzhag pa ni/ ro'am rus pa la dbang rgyas par bskur/ de bkrus pa'i chus 'jim pa bya/ rmang shabs su tshe 'das sogs kyi bar chad 'byung po'i ming gzhug /de'i steng du gnod sbyin 'khor lo dang zas sna 'bru sna sogs bcug nas tshul bzhin du brtsigs pa'i bum par rten de bzhag la/ sbyang khrus sngon du 'gro bas dpa' bo gcig pa'am dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs su bskyed/ /dgug gzhug cing mnyes dbang bskur rgyas gdab mchod bstod bzlas pa rdzogs par byas/ mchod rten grub nas rab gnas rgya cher bya'o/ khang khyim 'chad par bzhag pa ni/ rin po che'i shing sa las byas pa rab byung la dkar po mchod rten gyi dbyibs dge bsnyen la dmar po pad+ma kha sbyar| gzhan pho la gdan khri/ mo la sngau skya'i bil pa/ byis pa la dmar ser lhung bzed lta bu sogs legs par byas par bzhag /spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba la srad bu dmar po btags te nub phyogs kyi steng thog la gdags/ steng du gdugs khra bo phub/ /mtha' rin po che bdun dang mchod rdzas kyis bskor/ gzhan snga ma dang 'dra bar bya'o/ /ro bsreg pa ni/ sngar ma byas pa'i sa yin na/ sa brtag blang*| sbyang ba sogs sa chog gang 'grub bya/ sngar byas par blang sbyang mdor bsdus kyis chog /zhi ba'i thab mtshan nyid dang ldan pa brus rtsig bris gsum gang 'thad bya/ ma grub na*/ rams shog la pad dkar 'dab brgyad lte bar pad ma'am 'khor los mtshan pa bris pa bul chu nas bton pa bting*/

bud shing brtsig lugs dang ro 'jog lugs sogs mthong rgyud yod pa bya/ gzhan yaṃ shing sogs bsreg rdzas bsag bsham sbyin sregs cho gar gang bshad byas/ ro la 'di dang snga ma gnyis la'ang gdar yig sogs kyi chas 'jug bsnyen pa'i skabs bzhin bya/ dur ga dang gtso bo'i sngags bzlas pa'i dar ram ras dmar pos gdong g.yogs/ sngon du'am gdong khang du'am/ gnyis kar yang rung ste/ bskyed sbyang sogs/ dbang bskur mchod bstod kyi bar tshang bar byas nas me sbar| ye shes pa gshegs nas bar snang du'am rang gi snying kha'i sa bon la bzhag gson gcig sogs sngags dang bcas pa lan gsum dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung bas byang me sbar ba na spra brtag /ngan na bgegs bsregs bskrad bya/ de rting 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sbyin bsregs thams cad rang gi sbyin bsregs cho ga bzhin bya ste/ rgyas pa dngos grub rgyal mtsho las shes par bya'o/ /mthar tshogs 'khor lam sbyangs bstan sogs kyang bya la/ yang na byang bu bsreg pa'i skabs ltar bya'o/ khyad par dus 'khor la dam tshig gi rdzas so drug 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad dang sngags rgyas bsdus gang 'grub phyi nang mchod bcu sogs mchod phreng bzhin du 'bul lo/ / rus pa bsdus nas ri chur bskyel lam tsha tsha 'debs pa sogs gang byed kyang rus chog gal che bas/ me shing thal bar ma gyur gyi bar du sher phyin gyi mdo klog |ting shags brdung zhing rdo rje'i glu bya/ thal bar gyur pa dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing lag pa g.yas kyi rdo rje thab khung gtso bo'i mtshon ma'i bar du reg pas mtshan ma thams cad rdo rje la 'dus par bsam/ de nas rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas rus pa dang thal ba bsdus/ rdul tshon dkar pos 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bris me tog dkar po bcal du bkram pa'i steng du khaṃ phor gyi nang du rus pa bzhag rten bskyed pa nas lam byangs bstan gyi bar du bya bar ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes bshad/

ma grub na/ lhar bskyed dgug gzhug cing mnyes khrus gsol dbang bskur rgyas gdab bzlas pa bya/ yig brgya brjod de zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i phung por bsams nas zhib par btags/ dur ga dang gtso bo'i sngags bzlas pa'i dri bzangs dang ba byung lngas bsres pa'i chus bkru/ sa rko ba nas sku gzugs sam tsha tsha sogs gang 'grub byed pa'i gnas skabs kun du/ /che ge mo'i kā ya wāka tsit+ta dz+nyā na sarba pā paṃ bi shwa dha ya swāhā zhes bzlas shing*| gsham du yang sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa bris nas gzhug par sā dhu pu tras bshad pa ltar bya ste rab gnas bya ba ni bsdus pa'o/ /ri rtse 'am chur skyel na'ang mi lag mang po yod na phyogs skyong du bskyed pa sogs gong du bshad pa bzhin byas te rol mo sogs mchod pa dang bcas te bskyal nas rlung la bskur ba'am chur pho na gang reg gi sems can ngan song las thar pa sogs kyi phan yon gsungs so/ /tsha tsha 'debs tshul la cung zad rgyas par byed na/ sngar gyi 'jim pa'i gong bu la tshe 'das bkug ste lus ngag yid gsum sbyangs/ hūm̐ zhes ngag tu brjod pas thig ler zhu ste a thung du gyur pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa thams cad kyi gsungs dbyangs gsal bsdus la stim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta waka badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma kā haṃ/ a thung yongs su gyur te rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros thugs phyag mtshan thams cad bdus te stim/ tsit+ta/ de yongs su gyur pa las gtso bor gyur pa'i 'od kyis sku thams cad thim/ ka ya sbyar| byin gyis brlob pa'i sngags 'chad 'gyur nyer gcig brjod de rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor stim la/ 'od zer gyi phung por bsam pas sngags brjod pas btab ste/ re re'ang dkyil 'khor re re gyur par bsams nas dri'i thig le me tog gi tshom bus brgyan pa'i steng du bzhag nas sa dkar gsol/ gdugs la sogs pas brgyan/ lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su skye mched bzlas zhu ba'i mchod rten du bltas la shis rjod bya'o/

/rgyas par byed na/ tsha tsha 'debs pa'i yo byas bsags/ brtags ste rung pa'i sar sa blangs/ tshon skud la/ oṃ badz+ra pū tra sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes bzlas pas rgya tshad ci tsam 'os pa tshon skud kyis bskor ste mtha' mar phur gdab kyi cho gas phur pa bzhi btab/ yungs dkar dang dri bzang bsres pa la sngags bzlas pas phyogs bzhir gtor te/ oṃ badz+ra kha na kha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces bzlas pa'i rin po che bsams la rko/ brkos tshar ba dang bzhi hūm̐ brjod nas phur bu dbyung*/ ru ru phur ru bzlas pa'i 'o mas phur bu gdab/ sa rnams snod gtsang mar bzhag /oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra a lo ka ṇa pha hūm̐ phaṭa ces bzlas la brdung*| oṃ a mri ta hūm̐ phaṭa ces bzlas pa'i spos chu la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i 'od zer gyis spos chu khyab par 'khyil nas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsams la sbru/ oṃ badz+ra pra mar da na ya swā hā zhes bzlas te rdzis 'jim gang gi steng du/ lag pa g.yon pa gan rkyal du byas pa'i mtheb chung gis sen mo mthe bos :bsnan

[ mnan ] te/ sor mo gsum nas re tsam par phye nas bzhag pa'i steng du/ g.yas pa de ltar byas nas kha sbub pa bdud rtsi kha sbyor gyi phyag rgya reg nas/ oṃ na mo bha ga te bai ro tsa na pra bha rā dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar ha te/ samyak+saṃ bud dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ suk+ṣ+me suk+ṣ+me/ sa me sa ma ye/ shān+te dan+te/ sa mā ro pya/ a nā lam bhe ta raṃ baṃ be/ ya sho ba ti/ ma hā ste dze/ ni rā ku le/ nirbā ṇe/ sarba bud dha a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭha te swāhā/ nyer gcig brjod/ 'jim pa la 'od 'phros/ tshe 'das kyi don byas/ slar 'dus te/ rnam snang gi skur gyur zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i phung po gyur/ oṃ ba su dhe swā zhes pas 'jim pa bcad/ ye shes lnga'i 'od zer gyis 'gro ba'i don byas slar 'dus te 'bi 'bi la thim pas ye shes lngas rgyas gdab shel ltar dag par gyur/ oṃ badz+rod bha we swāhā/ gro ga'am shog gu la gur gum bzang pos dur ga dang gtso bo'i sngags sam yi ge drug pa'i mthar chai'i ge sarba markā wa ra ṇa shun+tiṃ ku ru na maḥzhes pa bris rab gnas bsdus pa byas pa grabs su bcug pas/ re re 'bi 'bi'i gsham du bcug / oṃ badz+ra dharmā dha tu gar+bhe dz+wa la swāhā/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes nang du zhugs par gyur| snum bkus la/ oṃ a ra de bi ra dze swā hā/ byang chub kyi sems 'gos par gyur/ rgyar bcug la/ oṃ dharmā dha tu gar+bhe swāhā/ thabs la 'brel pas chos dbyings su zhugs par gyur/ brdung zhing ye dharma/ ye shes chen por gcig tu gyur/ dbyung zhing dharmā ra te swāhā/ rgyu 'bras kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ phyung nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dharmā saṃ bho ga nirmā ṇa kā ya sa ma ya s+t+wa| sku gsung kyis don gnyis mthar phyin par gyur/ me tog gi gdan la bkod| oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swāhā/ mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi sha ta dībā+e dz+wa la dz+wa la dharma dhā tu gar+bhe swāhā/ rab tu gnas pas 'khor ba ji srid par sems can kyi don la bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud dhe ā ha ra ā ha ra a gats+tsha gats+tsha dharmā dhā tu gar+bhe swāhā/ rang bzhin dag pa'i ngang nas sems can gyi don la gshegs par gyur/ gnas gzhan du spyan drangs/ 'di ni zhi ba snying po dang a bha ba'i mchod rten gdab tshul te| de las kyang rgyas par byed na mchod rten gyi cha dbye ba nas 'byung ba bzhin bya'o/ /de ltar na gang zag dman pa la bya ba rgya cher bstan zin te/ da ni rang gi bla ma dngos sam de dang 'dra ba'i gang zag mchog la ni/ dbu rgyan rgyan drug na za bzang po khri chen po sogs sku khrus kyi dri bzang pos ji ltar bzang bas sgrub/ brab pa dang dug dbyung dang gsol gdab dang lam sbyang bstan rnams bzhagakhrus kyi spel tshig kyang sems can la sbyar/ de rting sta gon dang dbang dngos gzhi rnams bla ma de nyid kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gtso bo dang tha mi dad pa'i mdzad/ rang gis de'i mchod g.yog tu bsams nas rgyas par bya/ mchod bstod kyi skabs su bla ma spyi dgos kyi bstod pa dang gsol 'debs mang du bya/ gshegs gsol mi byed| gzhan bsnyen pa nas bzung ste snga ma ji bzhin bya ste/ dbang bskur nas gsol ba gdab pa'o/ /spur sbyangs te gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gdar yig bskyed gzhug sku khrus dbang bskur snga ma bzhin byas/ me 'jug khar ye shes pa nam mkhar bteg /chos 'brel med pas me gzhug /'jig rten pa'i me la sbyin bsregs tshar nas dkyil 'khor gsal gdab/ bla ma'i ye shes pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang tha mi dad par spyan 'dren gyi tshig bcad dang bcas te nam mkha' nas spyan drangs te med bzhugs su gsol ba la 'das pa'i sbyin bsregs rgyas par bya'o/ /'di rnams la'ang rten la rnam shes 'gugs pa'i tshe sngar bshad pa'i gsang ba'i phyag rgya dang sngags kyis byar rung ste/

sngags rgya des ni sangs rgyas thams cad 'gugs par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang 'di la sngon la spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad gang 'grub dang bcas te bya'o/ /mchod rten bzhengs te gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gdung rus la bskyed chog rgyas par byas te sbyin bsreg kyi dkyil 'khor yang bstim nas zhag mang du gsol ba gdab/ mchod bstod byas te zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i phung por bsams nas tsha tsha 'debs tshul sogs sngar bshad pa bzhin byas te/ sku gdung dang gdung thal bsregs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten gsum gang 'grub bzhengs te rab gnas bya'o/ /gnas skabs de rnams su gsol gdab dang*/ sbyin bsregs kyi spel tshig ni/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i bar du gcod pa dang bdag cag sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad shin+tiṃ ku ru na maḥzhes sam/ ku ru swāhā zhes sogs sbyar bar bya zhing rten gsum ji ltar bzhengs tshul dang gzungs bzhugs la sogs pa thams cad rgyas par dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las shes par bya'o/ /rang dang*/ chos 'brel med pa'i gang zag 'bring po dag la'ang phyir bzlog dbang bskur lam sbyangs bstan la sogs pa thams cad rang gi bla mas mdzad/ rang gis de'i grogs byed par mos nas dman pa la sbyar ba thams cad ji ltar ba bzhin du sbyar bas chog ste/ bu slob sogs kyi bsam pa dang bstun nas bya'o/ /de ltar bdun tshigs byed pa la dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /ro bsregs la sbyin bsregs rten bzhengs la rab gnas/ de dag rnal 'byor bla med la rten na tshogs 'khor cho ga sogs te/ 'di dag rdo rje 'chang gis rdo rje slob dpon gyi las su rgya cher gsungs pa na rdo rje theg pa'i sgo nas gzhan don byed na mi shes su mi rung ba'i bya ba yin pas/ rang nyid za chog la rgyug bzhin du rgyal bas gsungs pa'i cho ga rnam par dag pa la za chog gi ming btags pa'i sdang smras kyis ring du dor te/

rang gzhan bslu bar mi bya'i/ rab tu rgyud sde rin po che rnams dang*/ ji skad bshad pa'i rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung la 'dris par bya zhing de ltar mi nus pas bod kyi mkhas pa snga mas mdzad pa dang*/ kho bos sbyar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rnams dang*/ rten gsum bzhengs tshul dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ rab gnas cho ga dge legs rgya mtsho/ sbyin bsregs cho ga dngos grub rgya mtsho/ tshogs 'khor cho ga bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho rnams la legs par sbyangs te lag len du btab nas cho ga tshar rjes rang gzhan blo bde bar bya'o/ /dus mtha'i cho ga sgrib pa kun sbyong 'di| |dus 'khor la sogs rgyud mang las 'byung ba'i/ /dus mthar lho sgo'i cho ga byed tshul rnams/ /dus kyi sbyor bas rnam par nyams mthong nas/ /dus 'khor la sogs mdo sngags tshul rig ste/ /dus bzhin 'doms pa'i dge slong skad gnyis pa/ /dus shes pradz+nyā rat+nas legs par sbyar/ /dus mtha'i 'grau bas gtso byas sems can kun/ /dus rnams kun tu skyon gyi skabs bcom nas// dus kyi zhags pa'i dgra las rgyal ba dang*/ dus gsum gshegs pa'i lam kun myur bgraud de/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i go 'phang reg gyur cig /nongs pa mchis na nongs pa rgyu ma rig /lhar bcas bla mas slar yang gzhom du gsol/ /legs tshogs gzhan phan byed do lhag bsam can/ /rnams kyis blangs nas 'di bzhin spyod gyur cig /rgyal bas bsngags pa'i cho ga rgyang bsrings nas/ /log chos rol chas gshin po rang gzhan bslu/ /myos pa bsams nas legs par bsams pa'i tshe/ /yid 'byung 'gyur ba'i las kun spong bar shog /ces pa nyi sgrol byed ces bya ba shing pho spre'u'i lo sa ga'i zla ba gnyis byung ba'i phyi ma'i mar ngo'i bzang po gsum pa'i nyin/ /rong skyid gshongs su sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas 'phel bar gyur cig/ // maṅga laṃ/ shu bha mastu sarba dza ga tāṃ//
